title: The Lunar rock from the mission
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：lunar　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lunar 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the grandmother wrote of ① a lunar rock from the mission in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② so lunar that nobody in the courtyard would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the lunar ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the lunar rock from the mission that anybody there had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lunar to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the lunar ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lunar calendar of the village, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lunar as the calendar of the village they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lunar or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lunar, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite lunar; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the lunar ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, without complaint, she wrote of another lunar rock from the mission in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less lunar than anybody had expected. ⑩ The lunar calendar of the village that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the lunar ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 月球（前置定语 a lunar rock from the mission：1964 年祖母在日记里记下的那件月球的岩石）
B. adj. 月球／月亮（两处加强说法：so lunar that … 与 no less lunar than …）
C. adj. 月球／月亮（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 月球（表语 too lunar to do：母亲觉得它太月球，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 月亮（前置定语 a lunar calendar of the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩月亮的阴历）
F. adj. 月亮（同级比较 as lunar as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里用的阴历相比）
G. adj. 月亮（后置定语 something lunar：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 月亮（受程度副词修饰 quite lunar：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a lunar rock from the mission
the lunar rock from the mission that
a lunar calendar of the village
The lunar calendar of the village that

answers.why: lunar 意为“月球”，1964 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件月球的岩石”，此处作前置定语 a lunar rock from the mission。
lunar 意为“月球”，此处用 so lunar that 结构，说它月球到院子里没人敢靠近。
lunar 意为“月球”，日记上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的月球任务带回的月球岩石，等于最高级的说法。
lunar 意为“月球”，母亲认为这件东西“太月球了，谁也用不上”，too lunar to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lunar 意为“月亮”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩月亮的阴历”，此处作前置定语 a lunar calendar of the village。
lunar 意为“月亮”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里用的阴历一样月亮”，同级比较用 as lunar as。
lunar 意为“月亮”，日记上那半行字要的是“月亮的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lunar。
lunar 意为“月亮”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当月亮”，quite 修饰原级 lunar。
lunar 意为“月亮”，no less lunar than 表示“其月亮不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之月亮不亚于任何人的预料。
lunar 意为“月亮”，母亲 1976 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的月亮阴历”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件月球的岩石。（a lunar rock from the mission）
它月球到院子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so lunar that …）
母亲觉得它太月球，谁也用不上。（too lunar to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩月亮的阴历。（a lunar calendar of the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里用的阴历一样月亮。（as lunar as …）
到了 1971 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件月亮的东西。（something lunar）
answers: In 1964 the grandmother wrote of a lunar rock from the mission in the diary.
It was so lunar that nobody in the courtyard would go near it.
My mother thought it too lunar to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lunar calendar of the village.
He said nobody would call it as lunar as the calendar of the village they had once had.
By 1971 the diary asked for nothing but something lunar.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lunar 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the grandmother wrote of a lunar rock from the mission in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the lunar rock from the mission that anybody there had ever seen, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too lunar to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lunar calendar of the village, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite lunar, and everybody laughed.
The lunar ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
